features:
Features

100 Calories Per Bar
A light snack option that satisfies sweet cravings without overdoing it.

Made with Whole Grain Cereal
Crafted from real Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal squares, providing some whole grain content.

Crunchy and Chewy Texture
Combines the crunch of cereal with a chewy base and cinnamon icing drizzle.

Individually Wrapped
Perfect for school lunches, snacks at work, or travel.

Good Source of Calcium
Each bar provides about 10% of the recommended daily calcium intake.

Kid-Friendly Flavor
Loved for its sweet cinnamon taste and fun presentation. 

Benefits

On-the-Go Convenience
No prep needed—grab a bar and head out the door.

Family Favorite
Appeals to both kids and adults with its classic flavor and snackable format.

Nostalgic Cereal Experience
Offers the taste of Cinnamon Toast Crunch in a mess-free bar format.

Supports Bone Health
Calcium-enriched to help support daily nutrient needs.

Great for Portion Control
Individually sized to help manage snacking without guilt.
ingredients: Cereal (whole grain wheat, rice flour, sugar, maltodextrin, dextrose, canola and/or sunflower oil, salt, trisodium phosphate, caramel color. Vitamins and Minerals: iron and zinc [mineral nutrients], A B Vitamin [niacinamide], Vitamin B6 [pyridoxine hydrochloride], Vitamin B2 [riboflavin], A B Vitamin [folic acid]), Corn Syrup, Confectionary Coating (sugar, palm kernel oil, whey powder, soy lecithin), Crisp Rice (rice flour, barley malt extract, salt), Sugar, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Fructose, Canola Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Vegetable Glycerin, Calcium Carbonate, Maltodextrin, Palm Kernel Oil, Sorbitol, Whey Powder, Gelatin, Salt, Cinnamon, Color (caramel color, annatto extract, yellow 5 lake, yellow 6 lake, blue 1 lake, red 40 lake), Soy Lecithin, Natural Flavor, Fractionated Coconut Oil, Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B12, Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin D3.
